surfaces.matchText: Use for implementing accepted specs or review findings in the active workspace. Confirm the accepted contract, target workspace, target files or modules, and validation expectations before editing. This skill is local-only. Hand commit, push, merge, deploy, deletion, and external mutation to an owning strict skill.

Use for drafting compact specs, implementation contracts, or pre-work plans before editing. Include status, goal, boundary, inputs, outputs, plan, validation, and acceptance criteria. For skill specs, include match-check and Step 0 decisions. Do not write specs into the plugin install path.
safetyTerms: Do not write specs into the plugin install path

surfaces.matchText: Use for read-only single or triad reviews from a prepared packet. Confirm the request is read-only, the prepared packet is present and source-cited, mode is single or triad, and no file or external mutation is expected. Do not read detailed references until Step 0 passes.

Use for recording checked mechanical workflow or plugin failures. Confirm the failure is mechanically checkable, evidence or reproduction notes are available, and the affected workflow, plugin, skill, script, doc, or path is known. Stop if the issue is only a preference, hypothesis, broad idea, or user-directed scope change.
safetyTerms: Stop if the issue is only a preference
